purpose: Machine-readable evidence record for security hardening changes introduced in PR agent/security-hardening-v1

rules_added.description: Trust policy has wildcard Principal ('*') — any AWS identity or anonymous caller can assume this role.
rules_added.remediation: Replace '*' with specific account, service, or role ARN.

rules_added.description: Cross-account trust statement is missing sts:ExternalId condition. Enables confused-deputy attacks.
rules_added.remediation: Add StringEquals condition on sts:ExternalId with a non-guessable shared secret.

rules_added.description: Cross-account trust statement is missing aws:SourceArn condition. Any resource in the trusted account can trigger assumption.
rules_added.remediation: Add ArnLike or StringEquals condition on aws:SourceArn scoped to a specific resource ARN.

ci_hardening.permissions_added: contents: read (workflow-level, restricts GITHUB_TOKEN to read-only by default)
ci_hardening.bandit_scope: bandit -r src/ -ll (medium and above, all of src/)

sarif.notes: Emits a SARIF 2.1.0 document consumable by GitHub Code Scanning and SAST aggregators.
